stories.title: Hollywood program trains students for behind-the-scenes careers
stories.summary: Founded by George Clooney, Grant Heslov and Bryan Lourd, the Roybal Film and Television Magnet trains students for production crafts like camera work and sound. The program combines college-prep classes with hands-on instruction. The school remains optimistic about the future of the industry despite shifts in production and AI.

stories.title: AI career assessments aim to look beyond report cards
stories.summary: Abhishek Gupta, CEO of Gide.Ai, argues that traditional grading systems fail to capture a student's true strengths or interests. He suggests that AI-driven assessments could identify potential by evaluating how students approach problem-solving and communication, rather than relying solely on exam scores to dictate their future career paths.

stories.title: Coding prodigies find an alternative path to IITs
stories.summary: While 1.5 million students typically compete for IIT admission via the Joint Entrance Examination, a smaller group is gaining entry through the International Olympiad in Informatics. This contest, often called the Olympics of coding, provides a path for students with exceptional algorithmic aptitude to bypass standard entrance tests.

stories.title: UK immigration changes to impact Indian students and workers
stories.summary: The UK plans to adjust immigration rules in 2027, including potential changes to Skilled Worker salary thresholds and Graduate visa durations. The government aims to attract highly skilled international talent while adjusting the broader immigration framework, which may reshape career opportunities for Indian students and professionals in the country.

stories.title: International student interest in US rises after elections
stories.summary: Internal data from Studyportals shows a 40 percent increase in page views for U.S. on-campus programs between Nov. 1 and Nov. 8. This rise in interest follows two years of decline and comes after Democrats won control of Congress in the recent midterm elections.

stories.title: International students express concern over deportation risks
stories.summary: International students in the U.S. are reporting increased anxiety regarding campus immigration enforcement and potential deportations following the 2026 midterm elections. Many are seeking clarity on their visa status and safety as they navigate the current federal policy environment and its potential impact on their academic tenure.

stories.title: Research examines career intentions of international students
stories.summary: A paper by Professor Kim Hakseon of Pukyong National University has received a best paper award at an international conference. The research explores how experiential learning and various university factors influence the career choices international students make after graduation, providing new insight into their post-study professional trajectories.

stories.title: Odisha student wins National Science Seminar 2026
stories.summary: Soumyashree Thanapati, a Class 10 student from Odisha, secured the top position at the National Science Seminar 2026 in New Delhi. Competing against representatives from 33 states and territories, she won a 48,000 rupee scholarship for her presentation on India's energy future.

stories.title: Surat student wins innovation challenge with groundwater project
stories.summary: Dheyay Shah, a student at RMG Maheshwari English School, won the vivo Ignite 2026 national innovation challenge. His project, JALAAKAR, uses machine learning and historical data to estimate groundwater availability at the taluka level, aiming to support more informed water management practices across the region.

stories.title: IIST student wins national award for forest protection system
stories.summary: Omkar Manik Jadhav, an aerospace engineering student at IIST, secured second place in the IET India Scholarship Award 2026. He won 3 lakh rupees for developing a satellite-based technology solution designed to address threats to Indian forests, outperforming nearly 49,000 other undergraduate engineering applicants.

stories.title: Indian students finish fifth at World School Golf Championship
stories.summary: The International Schools Sports Organisation team placed fifth out of 19 teams at the ISF World School Golf Championship in Morocco. Student-athlete Devvrat earned a bronze medal in the Under-15 category, competing against golfers from across the globe in challenging conditions.

stories.title: Aaryavir Sehwag guides India to U19 Asia Cup semi-finals
stories.summary: Aaryavir Sehwag scored 160 runs off 168 balls against the UAE to secure India's spot in the U19 Asia Cup semi-finals. The youngster noted he promised his father, Virender Sehwag, a big score, acknowledging his father's preference for high-impact innings in competitive cricket matches.

stories.title: Pakistan begins selection for 2027 chemistry olympiad team
stories.summary: The first training camp for the 59th International Chemistry Olympiad has concluded in Karachi. Forty-four students underwent theoretical and laboratory assessments to begin the selection process. Four finalists will eventually be chosen to represent the country at the international competition in 2027.

stories.summary: Turkmenistan will host an electrical engineering olympiad on November 26. stories.summary: Sterling Bank and Educare have launched a mathematics and science olympiad in Nigeria to identify next-generation innovators. The initiative is part of the bank's corporate social responsibility efforts to equip young people with skills for a knowledge-driven world. The bank is currently seeking the next generation of talent.

stories.summary: Lviv Polytechnic National University will hold its 5th university-wide engineering and computer graphics olympiad on December 9. Students proficient in Autodesk AutoCAD are invited to compete in person. Participants may use university hardware or bring their own laptops, provided they have a licensed version of the software.

stories.title: Willich students win European robot championship
stories.summary: Three teenagers from Willich have won the World Robot Olympiad Championship Europe in Zagreb. The team built an autonomous robot using 3D-printed parts and commercial sensors to navigate an obstacle course. The machine achieved four maximum scores, proving that custom design can handle standard competition requirements.

stories.summary: Saudi students submitted 37,008 projects to the 2027 National Gifted Olympiad, a new record for the competition. The total represents a 7.83 percent increase over the previous year. The King Abdulaziz and His Companions Foundation for Giftedness and Creativity noted the growth in entries from across the country.

stories.summary: The Dhaka Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education will allow students to use eight specific models of non-programmable scientific calculators during the 2026 junior scholarship examination. The board has notified all examination centre secretaries of the approved list. Ordinary calculators are also permitted for use during the tests.

stories.title: Indian institutions rise in global rankings
stories.summary: Indian institutions continue to climb global league tables, with 52 schools ranked in the QS World University Rankings 2027. India now holds 143 spots in the Times Higher Education rankings. The number of Indian-affiliated researchers on the Stanford-Elsevier top scientist list also increased by double digits this year.

stories.summary: A directory of 142 scholarships has ranked awards by their total multiyear value rather than one-time payments. The list notes that renewable awards can count as taxable income. stories.summary: The Storage Center is accepting applications for its Fall 2026 Space to Succeed Scholarship until November 30. Three students nationwide will receive $5,000 awards for self-initiated community leadership. The company has granted $45,000 to nine students since the program launched in 2025. Leadership is now a measurable asset.

stories.title: Arkansas Tech students earn personal training scholarships
stories.summary: Four Arkansas Tech University students were awarded National Academy of Sports Medicine scholarships to pursue personal training certification. The recipients were selected from 453 applicants across 30 universities. The academy was created in 1987 to provide a consistent framework for trainer education, which is now free for these four.

stories.summary: Moore Family Law has selected a University of Houston senior as the winner of its Fall 2026 Leadership Excellence Scholarship. The firm awards $1,000 to students who demonstrate honesty and integrity. The scholarship recognizes driven individuals who have taken on leadership roles while working to become better versions of themselves.

stories.title: Lyford Cay Foundation awards scholarships to 23 students
stories.summary: The Lyford Cay Foundation has awarded scholarships to 23 Bahamian students for the 2026 cycle. Recipients are studying at institutions in Canada, the United States and the United Kingdom. Engineering and health sciences emerged as the most popular fields of study among the current cohort of awardees.

stories.summary: The AgricTech Empowerment Network is accepting applications for its 2026-2027 scholarship program. The initiative provides financial support to undergraduates in selected Nigerian regions who are interested in agricultural innovation. Successful applicants receive tuition assistance and certification, along with the opportunity for recognition on the organization's platform.

stories.summary: The National Graduate Institute for Policy Studies in Tokyo has opened applications for its 2027-28 master's and doctoral programs. Indian students are eligible to apply for studies in public policy, economics and technology policy. The institute also provides information on external scholarship schemes for international applicants.

stories.summary: Sonali Bank is accepting applications for its 2025 educational scholarship program until November 27. Underprivileged and meritorious students may apply for a one-time grant of 15,000 taka. stories.title: Himachal Pradesh to hire 3,100 teachers
stories.summary: The Himachal Pradesh government plans to recruit 3,100 teachers and 374 assistant professors ahead of the 2027-28 academic session. The hiring supports the launch of new CBSE-affiliated schools in the state. The recruitment process is being managed by the Himachal Pradesh Rajya Chayan Ayog.

stories.title: Himachal Pradesh to recruit 3,100 teachers for new schools
stories.summary: The Himachal Pradesh government will recruit 3,100 teachers for new CBSE-affiliated schools starting in the 2027-28 academic session. Education minister Rohit Thakur also noted that 9,287 tablets have been distributed to meritorious students. The state is now working to expedite the recruitment process through its official selection commission.

stories.title: TSC warns school heads against professional misconduct
stories.summary: The Teachers Service Commission has issued a warning to school heads regarding child abuse, falsification of records, and misuse of funds. Chairperson Jamleck Muturi stated that the greatest threat to the profession is the conduct of those who abuse the trust placed in them by parents and society.

stories.title: International student demand remains strong despite economic shifts
stories.summary: Industry leaders report that international student demand remains strong in major cities despite economic rebalancing. Data from the Funliving Global Partner Conference shows student inquiries rose 25 percent year-on-year, with confirmed accommodation bookings increasing by 19 percent. Studio and one-bedroom share bookings grew by 3.2 percent.

stories.title: Inquiry recommends enrollment ban for Sydney school
stories.summary: A parliamentary inquiry has recommended that Redeemer Baptist school be barred from enrolling new students following allegations of sexual, physical, and financial abuse. The report found the school breached child safeguarding standards. The school, run by the Redeemer Baptist Church, has faced claims of students sharing beds with teachers.

stories.title: Headteachers consider early exit following Ofsted inspections
stories.summary: More than half of headteachers polled after inspections under the new Ofsted regime are considering leaving their roles sooner than planned. While 64 percent described the new inspections as more intense, 86 percent reported struggling with their mental health while inspectors were on site. The experience is proving memorable.

stories.title: US school districts face closures as enrollment declines
stories.summary: Cash-strapped school districts across the U.S. are closing campuses to save money as birth rates decline and funding dries up. Research indicates student enrollment is falling faster than schools are closing, suggesting that districts will face further financial choices as they navigate the start of the academic year.

stories.title: Odisha removes attempt caps for civil services exam
stories.summary: The Odisha government has removed the limit on the number of attempts candidates can make for the state civil services examination. Aspirants from all categories may now appear for the test as many times as they wish, provided they remain within the prescribed upper age limit.

stories.title: Odisha approves 393.62 crore for college Wi-Fi
stories.summary: The Odisha Cabinet has approved the 393.62-crore Odisha Shikshanet scheme to provide free Wi-Fi in 601 government and aided colleges. The infrastructure rollout is scheduled for a three-year implementation period. The government describes the initiative as a significant push to bolster digital education infrastructure in the state.

stories.title: Climate education program sees rise in student interest
stories.summary: An evaluation of the Cambridge Climate Quest program across 18 schools found that student interest in climate issues increased from 40 percent to 61.2 percent. The program focuses on practical, evidence-based learning to help students understand environmental challenges and develop critical thinking skills for future employment.
